# AGEdge Global

> AGEdge Global is a Ghanaian architectural design and build firm delivering end-to-end building solutions across Ghana. We provide architecture, materials procurement, construction, and real estate development under one roof.

## About
- Founded: 2016
- Location: Number 1 Beige Street, Azumah, New Weija, Accra, Ghana
- GPS: GS-0065-2998
- Phone: +233 25 607 3041
- Email: info@agedgeglobal.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
